description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 is vulnerable to a path traversal and remote code execution flaw affecting misconfigured cgi-scripts.
recommendation: Upgrade Apache to 2.4.51 or later immediately.

description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 has an incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773, still allowing path traversal and RCE.
recommendation: Upgrade Apache to 2.4.51 or later immediately.

description: OpenSSH before 7.3 allows remote attackers to enumerate valid usernames via a timing side-channel during password authentication.
OpenSSH through 7.7 allows remote attackers to detect existence of users on a target system via a crafted authentication request (username enumeration).
vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a backdoor that can be triggered to gain a remote root shell.
recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd immediately and audit the server for compromise.

description: ProFTPD 1.3.3 is vulnerable to a stack-based buffer overflow that can lead to remote code execution.
recommendation: Upgrade ProFTPD to a patched version.

description: nginx before 1.4.1 is vulnerable to a stack-based buffer overflow via chunked transfer encoding, enabling remote code execution.
The Heartbleed bug in OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f allows attackers to read sensitive memory contents from the server.
recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later immediately.
